_doc: The castle kit's placements (docs/art/castle-kit.md, "`castle_kit.json`"). A cell listed under `cells` is kitted: tools/blender/greybox.py replaces its greybox render polygons with kit pieces; every other cell exports as before. Validated and resolved by tools/blender/castle_kit/schema.py against data/world/layout.json and props.json. Runs are `<surface>:<side><k>`: side n (z = min z, faces +z), s (z = max z), w (x = min x, faces +x), e (x = max x); k counts the runs of that side from low x / z, split at every walkable join (doors). Bays are solved per run (castle_kit/grid.py solve_bays, `bay_target` +-15 %, override with runs.<id>.bays) and numbered from low x / z; shafts stand on the inner bay boundaries. `arches`: one per door edge of the cell's surfaces, piece kit_stone_arch_<contact width>x<door ceiling>. `openings`: windows, niches and blind doors by run and bays (or a centre `t` on the 0.5 m grid), `sill` above the floor in whole 0.6 m courses. `lanterns`: a wall lantern on every inner shaft k with k % every == 0, its bracket `y` above the floor. `hero`: hand placements like props.json kit (id, piece, pos, yaw, args). `replaces`: props.json props or kit ids this cell's kit stands in for (not exported). Castle kit M2: `build` false = checked and resolved, not built yet; `springing` = a vaulted cell's cornice top and shaft tops above its floor; `shaft` plain (default: kit_stone_shaft_<h>_plain) or clustered; runs.<id>.bounds = explicit inner bay boundaries (t); openings may stand `over` a door (windows); arch `leaves` lie in the reveal or flat against this cell's wall face, and only one side of a door has them. `camera_max`: the manifest's per-cell camera.max (metres; absent cells use the default; the client caps Low at low_cap). Castle kit M3 + M4: `lines` = bay lines shared by every wall run along one axis (shafts and corbels on them; openings by `line_bays`); `wainscot` = an oak wainscot's height; `sky` = the enchanted ceiling's wall plate and ridge (castle_sky panels per line bay); `candles` = up to four floating-candle groups (moving nodes); `portraits` = wall rectangles filled with framed portraits (one band per level); `lanterns.spots` = wall lanterns at given t on walls without shafts; `shaft` none = no bay shafts; `railings` gallery_edge; `keep_clear` = layout areas no hero stands in; `replaces` may name a repeated prop by its id. Castle D1: `shade` (optional) = {"radius"?: m, "rays"?: n} overrides the vertex-AO bake's radius (0.5..6 m) and rays per vertex (16..256) of the cell's budget kind (castle_kit/grid.py AO_RADIUS, AO_RAYS); every kitted cell is baked. Castle M5a: the eight M5a cells started `"build": false` until their pieces existed; budget kind `tower` (castle_kit/grid.py BUDGETS) for the west tower; new opening pieces kit_door_class_3x4.5 (blind_door kind), kit_window_slit_0.6x2.4 and kit_window_rose_6x6 (windows); every M5a cell sets `shade`. Castle M5b: the twelve M5b cells start `"build": false` with their arches, materials, budget and `shade` only (then flipped); budget kinds `classroom` and `room`; the dungeon variants castle_wall_d and castle_floor_dungeon; a hero `kit_chandelier_ring` hangs in its own candle group (args.group, see grid.CHANDELIER); portraits may take `mix` still_life. Castle M5c: the courtyard started `"build": false` until its pieces existed, budget kind `courtyard`, its paving castle_floor_court; `facade` (on the facing cells of grid.M5C_FACADE_CELLS) = {sides, ext?, roof?, parapet?, buttresses?, pinnacles?}: the sides of the cell's outside the courtyard sees and what the facade rules put there; `ext` (default true) makes the cell's outside faces its exterior material clones (`<material>@ext`: the same textures, the client's outdoor sun-shadow flag).

gf_corridor_west._doc: Ground-floor west corridor, 26 x 9 x 8.4 m (x -28..-2, z 4..13, y 0): Entrance Hall west door (e), Grand Staircase L0 arch (w). Both long walls are outside walls: windows; niches in the end bays of the north wall (the armour find spot is in bay 0).

ff_corridor_north._doc: First-floor north corridor, 68 x 12 x 8.4 m (x -28..40, z -14..-2, y 9): Grand Staircase L1 arch (w), the Marble Staircase arch (s, x 12..20, a door surface of this cell). North wall: windows alternating with niches and the three classroom doors (blind doors replacing the greybox door boxes, near the classroom_door_2/3 landmarks; bay 7, across from the Marble Staircase arch, is the History of Magic door, a blind door where a niche was; class plaques over the doors of bays 5, 7 and 9: Transfiguration, History of Magic, Defensive Magic); the corridor-window find spot is by the window of bay 10. South wall: windows where it is an outside wall (x < 0 and beyond the Entrance Hall), niches where the Entrance Hall is behind it. East end wall: the Long Gallery arch (castle M5a N7, x 40..42, z -11.5..-6.5).

entrance_hall._doc: Entrance Hall, 32 x 40 x 20 m (x 0..32, z 0..40, y 0), castle kit M2 (docs/art/castle-kit.md): walls to a cornice at the 14 m springing line, a lierne vault in four 10 m bays along z (apex 20 m) with a fan vault over the stair head, the Marble Staircase (x 12..20, z 0..18) rising north to the Marble Arch, the dungeon and kitchen stairwells either side (railing edges: eh_floor_ws:n0 and eh_floor_es:n0 have no wall), the Owl Exchange court in the west third (x 0..12, z 22..38). Front doors 8 x 10 (south, to the courtyard) and Great Hall doors 6 x 9 (east) stand open with their leaves flat against the hall's wall face; the west door 5 x 6, the Marble Arch 8 x 7, the Undercroft Door 3 x 4.5 (north wall, x 1..4; castle M5a N1) and the Owl Gate 3 x 4.5 (south wall of the court, x 1..4, to the courtyard's Exchange Yard; castle M5c N5) have none. High windows in the north wall cannot open north: the first-floor corridor is behind the north wall from 9 to 18 m. The four high lancets (2.6 x 7, sill 9) sit at the north ends of both side walls, flanking the stair head, and over the Owl Exchange counter on the west wall; the traceried 8 x 8 window stands over the front doors. Six suits of armour in niches: both ends of the north wall, two on the west wall north of the court, two on the east wall. Shafts (plain) at 5 m where the wall is clear, on the vault lines z 10, 20, 30 where it can be (runs.bounds), none behind the counter or where the door leaves lie. Built since castle kit M2 (Pieces); "build": false would validate it without building it. Castle M5c (Courtyard): the Owl Exchange court is dressed east of the counter's reach (the hero ids court_*): a rug, a free-standing notice wall by the north railing, a perch tree with owls and two stacks of crates and parcels along the south wall, clear of the counter, the Owl Gate's approach and the front doors' west leaf (grid.EH_COURT_KEEP_CLEAR); castle_props and castle_wood only, no new draw. The Clubs and Societies desk (hero ids clubs_*): a study table, a chair and a reading lamp against the east wall in its southern bay (z 35..40, between the shaft at 35 and the south wall), opposite the Owl Exchange counter, where the clubs secretary stands (data/npcs/routines.json eh_clubs_desk); it keeps clear of the Great Hall doors, the suits of armour and every NPC route through the hall (sim_core npcs test the_clubs_desk_keeps_clear_of_every_npc_route).

great_hall._doc: Great Hall, 66 x 22 m, layout ceiling 29 m (x 34..100, z 9..31, y 0), castle kit M3 (docs/art/castle-kit.md). Nine arch-braced oak trusses at x = 34 + 7.5 k (k 0..8: x 34 engaged on the door gable, then the eight bay lines 41.5..94), springing from corbels at 12 m on plain shafts that stand on the 3.2 m oak wainscot (`lines`); the wall plate (cornice, springing) at 17.5 m; the enchanted ceiling (`sky`, castle_sky) in two pitches per bay up to the 28.5 m ridge. Bays 0..7 of 7.5 m from the doors and the 6 m dais bay 8 (94..100). 2-light lancets (3.2 x 10, sill 6.6) in every side bay but the fireplace bay (north, bay 5) and the dais bay; the 9 x 12 end window over the dais (sill 5.4 above the dais floor); the hooded fireplace centred on the find-spot glint at x 74.5. Fourteen beast braziers (four neutral designs a..d: hart, bear, boar, hound) on the seven inner lines 41.5..86.5 of both walls at 8 m. Eight house banners on the two gables (west beside the doors, east beside the end window). Four house tables with benches (the props' rectangles), the staff table, chairs and high chair on the dais, the owl lectern before the dais steps, the hourglass set on the north wall by the dais (landmark house_points; each glass's sand a moving node `hourglass_sand_house_<x>` the client fills with the House Cup standings), the House Cup banners (four groups `cup_banners_house_<x>`, kit_banner_cup_<x>: eight 1.8 x 7.2 m house banners a row floating over the two long tables, z 11.8 and 28.2, from 17 m, facing the doors; each house on its own x, 1 m apart, so a tie hangs side by side; the client shows only the winners'), table settings, four floating-candle groups (moving nodes). The Dueling Club's stage, area (x 55..79.5, z 14..26) and spectator spots stay as they are (`keep_clear`); its props.json kit (stage, inlay, spectator benches, banners re-hung under the stage bay's windows) is kept. "build": true since its pieces exist (M3).

grand_staircase._doc: Grand Staircase, ground floor to the third-floor galleries (L0-L3), castle kit M4 (docs/art/castle-kit.md): the 36 x 36 m tower (x -66..-30, z -16..20), 9 m storeys, galleries 4.5 m north and south and 7.75 m west and east round a 20.5 x 27 m void. No bay shafts (`shaft` none: the tower walls rise 72 m); the gallery edges (`railings` gallery_edge: corbel table, cornice, balustrade) on every railing run; the derived flights (x-crossings 0-1 and 2-3, the z half-flights 1-2) on their corbelled landings (hero, one per landing surface, origin at the supporting gallery edge, +z into the void) and the pier landing 1-2 on the pier stack (hero `pier`: solid from the floor to under the first pier landing, then slender corner colonnettes up to the pier landings at 31.5 and 49.5, so no landing floats); the compass inlay round the pier's foot; 5 x 6 arches at the L0 and L1 east doors and the L2 and L3 west doors. Portrait clusters on every wall of every level (y 0.9..7.5 above the level's floor, split at doors, castle_portraits_a, one band l<level> each: LOD1 beyond one storey); six wall lanterns a level (spots, 3.6 m). Built (castle kit M4): the drop of the three z-landings over the x-flights is capped at 0.9 m (one corbel course) so 2.4 m stays clear over the flight.

grand_staircase_upper._doc: Grand Staircase, the crossings from the third floor up and the galleries L4-L7, castle kit M4 (see grand_staircase): the z half-flights 3-4 and 5-6 through the pier landings at 31.5 and 49.5, the x-crossings 4-5 and 6-7 and their corbelled landings, the L4-L6 west doors' arches (5 x 6), portrait clusters on castle_portraits_b (bands l4..l7; the L7 north wall split at the arch to the seventh-floor corridor), six lanterns a level, the skylight lantern at the 72 m ceiling. Replaces the greybox frame and canvas strips. Built (castle kit M4).

l7_corridor_north._doc: Seventh-floor corridor, 21 x 10 x 8.4 m (x -59..-38, z -28..-18, y 63), castle kit M4: kitted so the guardian portrait (our own design, canvas 63 of castle_portraits_b, `kit_portrait_guardian_a`) can hang in the common-room door's arch (3 x 4) on its north wall; the 5 x 6 arch to the Grand Staircase's L7 gallery on its south wall; blind doors at both ends replacing the greybox end doors (class plaques over both, the Divination classroom west, the Astronomy Tower east); lanterns on the shafts replacing the greybox torches (their lights stay). Built (castle kit M4).

sf_corridor_west._doc: Second-floor west corridor, 24 x 9 x 8.4 m (x -92..-68, z -2..7, y 18), castle M5a (Corridors): lancets in every bay of both outside walls; the 5 x 6 Library Arch (sf_library_door, castle M5b layout N4) at the west end into the Second-Floor Library, where M5a had a blind door, so the west wall is two 2 m runs (w0, w1); the 5 x 6 arch to the Grand Staircase's L2 gallery (e).

tf_corridor_west._doc: Third-floor Charms corridor, 24 x 9 x 8.4 m (x -92..-68, z -2..7, y 27), castle M5a (Corridors): five 4.8 m bays so the Charms class door (kit_door_class_3x4.5, replacing the greybox of the props.json kit charms_door; the interactable stays) is centred in bay 2 at x -80; lancets in n0 bays 1 and 4 (bay 0 keeps the loose-stone tell, bay 3 the notice board) and every s0 bay; the 5 x 6 arch to the Grand Staircase (e) and the reveal of the tower's 4 x 6 wt_door (w).

l4_corridor_west._doc: Fourth-floor west corridor, the Portrait Gallery: 16 x 9 m (x -84..-68, z -2..7, y 36) and its N3 vestibule l4_vestibule (x -92..-84, z -4..7), castle M5a (Corridors): portrait clusters on both north walls (band l4, castle_portraits_b, replacing the greybox tapestry and frames); lancets on the south walls; the 5 x 6 arch to the Grand Staircase (e) and the reveal of the tower's 4 x 5 wt_door_l4 (vestibule, w).

l5_corridor_west._doc: Fifth-floor west corridor, the Tapestry Corridor: 16 x 9 m (x -84..-68, z -2..7, y 45) and its N3 vestibule l5_vestibule (x -92..-84, z -4..7), castle M5a (Corridors): four invented tapestries on castle_tapestry (three tall ones between the north wall's shafts, the first beside the tapestry-corner tell at x -83; the wide one on the vestibule's north wall), replacing the greybox tapestries; lancets on the south walls; the 5 x 6 arch to the Grand Staircase (e) and the reveal of the tower's 4 x 5 wt_door_l5 (vestibule, w).

l6_corridor_west._doc: Sixth-floor west corridor, the Armour Gallery: 16 x 9 m (x -84..-68, z -2..7, y 54) and its N3 vestibule l6_vestibule (x -92..-84, z -4..7; its north wall is common room C's), castle M5a (Corridors): a niche in every bay of both corridor walls with a suit of armour (kit_armour_suit, reused) in each, replacing the greybox suits; a lancet on the vestibule's south wall; the 5 x 6 arch to the Grand Staircase (e) and the reveal of the tower's 4 x 5 wt_door_l6 (vestibule, w).

west_tower_stair._doc: West tower spiral stair, 12 x 12 m (x -106..-94, z -4..8), L3 (27) to the L6 landing (54), shaft to 60.75, castle M5a (Tower): budget kind tower; no bay shafts (shaft none); the flights (kit_stair_flight, nosing_stone) round the arcaded newel core kit_spiral_core_4 (replacing wt_core_cap); six slit windows climbing with the stair, one per lowest-turn outer run; the arches of its own doors: wt_door (4 x 6, L3), the N3 doors wt_door_l4..l6 (4 x 5) and common room C's cr_c_door (4 x 4.5) with the closed knocker door kit_door_knocker_a in it (replacing cr_c_door_leaf and cr_c_knocker); wall lanterns on the north-east corner landings replacing the greybox torches (their lights stay).

gf_undercroft._doc: The Undercroft Walk (N1), 60 x 12 x 8.4 m (x -28..32, z -14..-2, y 0) under the first-floor north corridor, castle M5a (Corridors): robed statues (kit_statue_robed_a / _b) in niches along the north wall (n0 bays 2-4, n1 at t 11 and bay 1), lancets in its outer bays (n0 0, 1; n1 2, 3; the middle of the wall faces the M5b Trophy Room), the 5 x 6 Trophy Room Arch (trophy_door, castle M5b layout N2) at x 2..7 where M5a left bay 5 plain, so the north wall is two runs (n0 x -28..2, n1 x 7..32 with bounds 14, 20, 26 keeping M5a's shaft lines) and every bay of the south wall's west run (s1 faces the Entrance Hall: no windows); the dry well kit_well_dry at the Undercroft Well landmark (14, 0, -8); the 5 x 6 west arch into the Grand Staircase and the 3 x 4.5 Undercroft Door into the Entrance Hall.

ff_gallery_east._doc: The Long Gallery (N7), 54 x 10 x 8.4 m (x 42..96, z -14..-4, y 9), castle M5a (Corridors): lancets in every south bay and the even north bays (n1 bays 2-8; bay 0 is the north door), robed statues in niches in the odd north bays (every 12 m), the 3 x 4.5 Long Gallery North Door (gallery_north_door, castle M5b layout, extra loop 2) at x 43.5..46.5 to the Trophy Stair, so the north wall is two runs (n0 x 42..43.5, n1 x 46.5..96 with bounds on M5a's shaft lines 48..90), the rose window kit_window_rose_6x6 in the east end wall (one 10 m bay, sill 1.2), the 5 x 6 Long Gallery Arch from the first-floor north corridor (w).

dungeon_west._doc: Dungeon Steps and Dungeon Corridor, steps 4 x 18 (x 5..9, z 4..22, 0 -> -9) and corridor 9 x 28 x 8.4 m (x 3..12, z 22..50, y -9), castle M5b (Dungeons): the dungeon stone (castle_wall_d, castle_floor_dungeon); a round barrel vault kit_vault_barrel_9x28 springing at 5.4 m (rise 3, its crown at the 8.4 m ceiling) with transverse ribs on the bay lines z 27.5, 36 and 44.5 (runs.bounds put a shaft under every rib foot on both walls; the vault's north end is capped over the stairwell, x 5..9); wall torches kit_torch_wall on those shafts, the west ones at the greybox torches' lights (which stay); the steps on kit_stair_flight (solid: they run between walls); the reveals of the Potions door (w), the Scullery Door (e) and common room D's stone wall door (s), which kit_door_stone_hidden closes as a plain stretch of wall (its arch keeps no rim or quoins, rules.py M5B_PLAIN_ARCHES; walk-through, the house gate is the server's). Replaces the greybox torches, brackets, chains and the wall panel cr_d_wall_panel. The two find-spot tells stay.

basement_east._doc: Kitchen Steps and Kitchen Corridor, steps 4 x 18 (x 23..27, z 4..22, 0 -> -9) and corridor 40 x 9 x 8.4 m (x 21..61, z 22..31, y -9), castle M5b (Dungeons): the warm stone (castle_wall_b, castle_floor_long) under the flat ribbed ceiling (the warm east basement reads unlike the vaulted dungeon west); still lifes (invented, from the portrait sheets' still-life canvases) in two hangs on the north wall (hero kit_portrait_* frames: the schema's portrait bands are l0..l9, so the basement cannot take `portraits` clusters; replacing kc_still_life and its frames); torches kit_torch_wall on the south wall at the greybox torches' lights (which stay); the Fruit Bowl Painting kit_door_painting standing over the kitchen door (kitchen_painting_door: its arch keeps no rim or quoins, walk-through, replacing kc_painting and its frame); common room B's barrel door (cr_b_barrels, 3.5 x 3.5): kit_barrel_stack on its corridor face (replacing the greybox barrels cr_b_barrel_r0..r4). The steps on kit_stair_flight (solid). The find-spot tells stay.

dungeon_classroom._doc: The Potions classroom, 21 x 21 x 8.4 m (x -20..1, z 26..47, y -9), castle M5b (Dungeons): budget kind classroom (at most 70 k triangles with the pc_* kit it keeps); the dungeon stone; a low round barrel vault kit_vault_barrel_21x21 along z (springing 5.4 m: the greybox stone columns' tops; rise 3) whose three transverse ribs land on the columns and on corbels (the side walls keep no bay shafts: the shelves and columns stand there); torches; a stone kitchen hearth (kit_hearth_kitchen, its flue up into the vault's lunette) in the south wall's middle bay with a few pots on its step. The kitted walls and floor replace the greybox pc_wall_* panels and pc_floor, the kit torches pc_torch_ne/se; the four cauldrons pc_cauldron_1..4 are interactable positions and stay (never replaced, never moved), as do the shelves, desk, blackboard, cupboard, barrels, columns and chandeliers; the 4 x 5 door to the dungeon corridor (e).

common_room_house_b._doc: Common room B (display name unchanged), 25.5 x 21 x 8 m (x 63..88.5, z 9..30, y -9), castle M5b (Dungeons): the warm stone under low oak beams (kit_beam_ridge, reused, on the bay lines x 69.5, 76, 82 and across at z 14 and 25: the beamed ceiling drops the stone ribs, rules.py M5B_BEAMED); two round dorm doors (kit_door_dorm round, house 1) on the north wall between the shafts; round sun windows that glow (kit_window_glow, glow_sun) over the plants in copper pots (kit_plant_pot) along the south wall; the copper-hooded hearth (kit_hearth_kitchen hood 1, its flue to the ceiling) on the east wall with the room furniture set in house_b (cover 1, rug field 1) at the fire, a round table with study chairs, a second sofa and rug, shelves of jars, the noticeboard, copper lamps (kit_lamp_hanging) at the greybox lamps' lights. Replaces the greybox furniture, beams, windows, lamps, plants, shelves, the dorm door and the hearth; the crafting stations, the find-spot tell and every greybox light stay. The 3.5 x 3.5 barrel door (w; the barrel stack stands on the corridor side, basement_east's).

common_room_house_d._doc: Common room D (display name unchanged), steps 4 x 18 (x 5..9, z 51.5..69.5, -9 -> -18) and room 32.5 x 20 x 11 m (x -8..24.5, z 69.5..89.5, y -18), in the dungeons: the dungeon stone under the flat ribbed ceiling; four lake windows that glow (kit_window_glow, glow_lake, pointed, two lights) between the south wall's shafts (runs.bounds) at the greybox lake lights, a soft moonlit teal-blue view whose light swells slowly (props.json ripple), never the room's key light; brass lanterns (kit_lamp_hanging glow 1, palette glow_lantern) on long chains at the greybox lamps' warm lights, so faces and the room are lit candle-warm and the green stays in the fabrics; the hooded fireplace (kit_fireplace_hooded_4.4x3.6, an opening, reused) in the east wall's middle bay, burning bigger (rules.py BLAZING_HEARTHS) as the room's focal point, its light reaching the sofas; leather sofas (cover 4) facing across a house_d rug (field 3) at the fire with armchairs in house_d (cover 3); a study table with chairs under the lamps, a round table, a brass candlestick on each table (kit_divination_set with no places and the candle in the middle), shelves of jars, the noticeboard, the dorm door (kit_door_dorm, house 3), house banners (kit_banner_d) on the north wall. The hidden stone door kit_door_stone_hidden is a hero of dungeon_west (the greybox wall panel cr_d_wall_panel is that cell's prop); here the 4 x 4.5 cr_d_wall arch on the steps' top (n) keeps no quoins (they would lie in the steps' side walls, rules.py M5B_FLUSH_ARCHES); the steps on kit_stair_flight (solid). Replaces the greybox windows, mullions, lamps, fireplace, rug, sofas, armchairs, table, tapestries and the dorm door; the crafting stations, the find-spot tell and every greybox light stay.

kitchens._doc: The Kitchens (N6), 22 x 12 x 8.4 m (x 36..58, z 33..45, y -9), castle M5b (Dungeons): budget kind room; the warm stone under the flat ribbed ceiling; four long tables (kit_table_house_6.5 with kit_bench_6.5 either side, reused: the benches' seats export) in two rows of two along the room, the aisle between them running from the painting door (n) to the hearth (kit_hearth_kitchen on the south wall, its stone hood and flue up to the ceiling, its raised step a floor seat, its fire the room's light; runs.bounds keep the bay shafts off it), pots (kit_pots_set) on every table and the hearth step, racks of copper pans (kit_pans_hanging) over every table, shelves of jars (kit_shelf_wall) beside the door, torches with lights on the north wall's shafts; the painting door (n) and the Scullery Arch (w).

scullery_passage._doc: The Scullery Passage (extra loop 1), 20 x 6 x 8.4 m (x 14..34, z 37..43, y -9) under the Entrance Hall, castle M5b (Dungeons): a corridor in the dungeon stone with the dungeon corridor's round barrel vault (kit_vault_barrel_6x20 along x, springing 5.4 m, semicircular) and its ribs on the bay lines x 20.5 and 27.5 (runs.bounds), torches on those shafts (the north ones bring the passage's two lights: it had none), and a scullery rack of jars with pots on its top in the south wall's middle bay; the 4 x 5 Scullery Door (w) and Scullery Arch (e, into the Kitchens).

common_room_house_a._doc: Common room A (display name unchanged), 23 x 21 x 12 m (x -61..-38, z -51..-30, y 63), castle M5b (Upper rooms): the warm stone; tall tower windows (kit_window_lancet_2.6x7, sill 2.4) in the outer bays of the north and west walls (explicit bounds: three bays each, the middle ones for the dorm door and the hearth) over low bookcases; the tall hearth (kit_fireplace_hooded_4.4x3.6, its hood to 9 m) in the west wall's middle bay on the greybox fire's spot, with lanterns on the shafts either side; the furniture set in house_a: a sofa and two wing armchairs on a rug before the fire, the leather sofa with the round table, a study table with four chairs, a reading table by the bookcase, the noticeboard by the portrait door, the dorm door in the north wall's middle bay (on the dorm stairs' interactable), a ring chandelier (candle group 0) over the room's middle; two house banners and a tapestry; the crafting stations and the hearth's find-spot glint stay. The 3 x 4 portrait door (s; the guardian portrait is l7_corridor_north's).

common_room_house_c._doc: Common room C (display name unchanged), 24 x 24 x 14 m (x -112..-88, z -30..-6, y 54), castle M5b (Upper rooms): the corridor stone; vaulted (springing 9 m: the cornice and the shafts' tops) under the starry dome kit_dome_starry_24, a ribbed domical vault of castle_sky panels (stars at night, the sky's tint by day) rising 4.9 m to a gilt star boss; the scholar statue (kit_statue_scholar: the robed scholar on a pedestal, invented) at its landmark under the ring chandelier (candle group 0) hung from the boss; tall windows (kit_window_lancet_2.6x7, sill 1.2) in the north wall's outer bays (explicit bounds: the middle bay holds the dorm door, kit_door_dorm in house_c, on the dorm stair's interactable) and the east wall's first three bays, each with drapes in house_c; bookcases in the west wall's first three bays, the south wall's bays (the notice board, kit_noticeboard, in the place of bookcase_s2, for the notice_board_house_c interactable) and beside the dorm door, study tables with chairs before them; a sofa, two armchairs and a round table on a rug in house_c by the east windows; the crafting stations and the bookshelf find-spot glint stay. The 4 x 4.5 door from the west tower's top landing (s; the knocker door is the tower's).

sf_library._doc: The Second-Floor Library (N4), 18 x 20 x 8.4 m (x -112..-94, z -4..16, y 18), castle M5b (Upper rooms): budget kind room; the warm stone; bookcase walls (kit_bookcase_<w>x4.8, oak, books in the palette's book_* names) between the shafts of every wall, four free-standing double stacks (kit_bookcase_4x3.6 back to back) south of the map making aisles, the floor map inlay kit_floor_inlay_map_7x5 (an invented island plan) round the Library Floor Map landmark (-103, 18, 6) under a ring chandelier (candle group 0), two long reading tables with chairs and lamps (each lamp brings a light) north of it; the 5 x 6 Library Arch (e).

trophy_room._doc: The Trophy Room (N2), 20 x 14 x 8.4 m (x -6..14, z -30..-16, y 0), castle M5b (Upper rooms): budget kind room; the corridor stone; thirteen oak trophy cases (kit_trophy_case: invented cups, plates, orbs, obelisks and shields on their shelves, a shield board with a house shield and two plaques over each) along the walls between the shafts; a lancet in the north wall's middle bay; the Hanging Armillary (kit_armillary, its glowing orb brings a light) at its landmark (4, 0, -23); lanterns on the shafts; the 5 x 6 Trophy Room Arch from the Undercroft Walk (s) and the 3 x 4.5 east door to the Trophy Stair (e).

trophy_stair._doc: The Trophy Stair (extra loop 2): the passage 10 x 5 (x 16..26, z -23..-18, y 0), the straight flight 16 x 5 (x 26..42, 0 -> 9, 29 degrees) in a stairwell with a flat ceiling at 17.4 m, and the landing 6 x 7 (x 42..48, z -23..-16, y 9), castle M5b (Upper rooms): a corridor in the corridor stone; kit_stair_flight (nosing_stone; walls both sides, no railings: built solid, the Upper rooms rule), lanterns on the passage's shafts and the landing's north wall, two hanging lanterns down the stairwell, two tapestries climbing the stairwell's north wall, a robed statue in a niche facing the flight at the landing's east wall; the 3 x 4.5 doors into the Trophy Room (w) and the Long Gallery (s, its north door).

courtyard._doc: Entrance Courtyard, 68 x 48 m (x -18..50, z 42..90, y 0), open to the sky, its own 16 m walls on all four sides, castle M5c (docs/art/castle-kit.md 'Exterior'). Doors: the front doors 8 x 10 (n, the hall's door surface: the hall's arch has the leaves, the courtyard's arch none), the Owl Gate 3 x 4.5 (n, x 1..4, into the Exchange Yard, x -18..8, z 42..58), the courtyard gate 8 x 10 (s, its own door surface, under the gatehouse). Kitted with open pointed arcades (kit_arcade_bay_6, 6 m bays, the pier line 3 m off the wall, lean-to slate roofs on oak rafters) along the north wall either side of the doors (x -15..-3 and 29..47) and down the west and east walls (z 45..87), meeting at corner piers (-15, 45) and (47, 45) round two small light-wells, and (castle M5c review) along the south wall either side of the gatehouse (x -15..3 and 29..47), meeting the side arcades at corner piers (-15, 87) and (47, 87) round two more; the tiered fountain at the Courtyard Fountain landmark (replacing the greybox basin and column; its coping a seat on four sides); the gatehouse round the courtyard gate (towers x 7..12 and 20..25 to 23 m, a machicolated gallery over the gate, the raised portcullis's teeth 6.4 m up; the gate arch without quoins, the towers frame it); six lamp posts with lights (the front axis, the gate, the yard); the Exchange Yard's five market stalls (awnings house_a..d by args.house), a bench and two noticeboards under the north-west arcade; benches under the side arcades and facing the fountain; six planters with sparse trees; the paving castle_floor_court. Kept clear: the front doors' apron, the Owl Gate's approach, the gate's passage (grid.COURT_KEEP_CLEAR) and the traceried window's hole over the front doors (grid.FRONT_WINDOW_OUTSIDE); the find-spot tells stay visible in the light-well (north-east) and the south-west corner. The facade rules put the parapet and pinnacles on the wall tops (`facade`) and make every face of the cell its exterior clone (`@ext`).

clock_courtyard._doc: N8 (Wings A; docs/art/castle-kit.md): the Clock Tower Courtyard, 46 x 24 m (x 62..108, z 50..74, y 0), open to the sky, the M5c courtyard kind, and its passage from the Entrance Courtyard (x 50..62, z 62.5..69.5: the courtyard's 5 x 6 arch, open into the Clock Tower Courtyard). An open arcade (kit_arcade_bay_6, six bays x 68..104) along the north wall under the Clock Tower; the Clock Tower's face (kit_clock_face_7, its centre 30 m up) on the tower's south face over the arcade (the tower itself is the far silhouette's clock_tower mass, its face 0.3 m behind the north wall's plane so the two never z-fight; the clock face hangs on it at z 49.7); the south wall cut down to a 1.2 m parapet over the crag with a coping (kit_parapet_coping; assemble.clock_parapet_p3c), the covered bridge leaving it at x 101..107; a dry well south of the Clock Tower Courtyard landmark, four lit lamp posts, two benches and two planters; paving castle_floor_court. Keep-outs keep_out.json clock_*.

covered_bridge._doc: N8 (Wings A; docs/art/castle-kit.md): the covered timber bridge, 6 x 18 m (x 101..107, z 74..92), rising 2.06 m from the Clock Tower Courtyard's south parapet to the stone circle's landing on the grounds: the `bridge` kind draws its hero only (kit_bridge_covered: a plank deck on two stringers, a timber truss each side with X braces, a hand rail and a knee rail between the posts, the sides open above them, tie beams, a shingled gable roof, two stone piers; LOD1 beyond grid.FACADE_LOD); none of the Planner's walls, ceiling or roof (its camera collider keeps them).

tf_corridor_east._doc: N9 (Wings A; docs/art/castle-kit.md): the east wing on the third floor (y 27): the East Wing hall (x -28..-18, z -12..14) off the Grand Staircase's two third-floor east doors (the balcony's 5 x 6 arch, the gallery's 4 x 5 door to its north) and the Third-Floor Corridor (x -18..34, z -12..-4) to its locked door at the east end. The corridor kit: 4.8 m bays with plain shafts, wall lanterns on every second shaft, lancets in every bay of the corridor's outer south wall and the hall's east wall; the locked door (kit_door_locked_3x4.5: the blind door's oak pair barred by an iron bar with a padlock) centred in the east end wall at the Locked Door landmark; two of the M5a tapestries in the hall; the 4 x 5 Hospital Wing door in the corridor's north wall.

hospital_wing._doc: N9 (Wings A; docs/art/castle-kit.md): the Hospital Wing, 36 x 12 x 9 m (x 0..36, z -26..-14, y 27), the room kind: 6 m bays with plain shafts and their vault ribs, tall lancets (2.6 x 7) in every bay of the outer north wall, a wall lantern on every shaft; ten iron beds (kit_bed_ward: linen, a wool blanket, a bedside cabinet with a jug), six under the north windows and four along the south wall either side of the 4 x 5 door from the Third-Floor Corridor; three folding screens (kit_screen_ward) between beds. The beds and screens are keep-outs (keep_out.json hospital_*).

owl_loft._doc: N10 (Wings B): the Owl Loft on its knoll (x -90..-78, z 118..130), the west tower's spiral reused (two laps of 9 m from the knoll's top at 4.14, kit_stair_flight_stepped round the arcaded newel core kit_spiral_core_4, up to the loft's slab), the open loft at 22.14; budget kind tower. The tower itself is the hero kit_owl_loft_shell over the layout's owl_loft_wall_* solids: 1 m walls, the warm corridor stone inside (castle_wall_c stays the Grand Staircase's) and the outside stone castle_wall_c@ext (the one outside stone), the pointed east door in the 4 m gap, slit windows climbing with the stair, three open pointed arches a side round the loft (no glass), plinth and eaves bands, a steep slate spire with an iron and gilt finial, flagstones on the ground floor; its LOD1 the plain outside and the spire. On the loft: short oak perches on the piers, straw, the owl mail (kit_owl_mail: an oak lectern-cabinet with a brass letter slot, our own design) at the owl_mail interactable; owls are the empty marker nodes owl_loft.owl_<k> (assemble.py: on the perches and the open arches' sills) for the client's owl prop. Every railing the rules hang on the tower's walls and the core is dropped (the walls and the core stand there); the loft's two railings over the stairwell stay.

l7_corridor_east._doc: N11 (Wings B): the seventh-floor east corridor, 42 x 12 m (x -28..14, z -2.5..9.5, y 63), off the Grand Staircase's two seventh-floor east doors (4 x 5 arches, the balcony's and the gallery's); the corridor kit in the warm stone: the north wall's bays (runs.bounds) with lancets in all but the middle one, where the Tapestry of the Patient Weaver hangs (kit_tapestry_weaver: invented, flat cloth on the props atlas) opposite the Blank Wall landmark; lanterns on its shafts; a lancet in the east end wall. The long south wall is left plain on purpose (no bays, shafts, openings or dressing: Wishing Room door).

dungeon_cellars._doc: N12 (Wings B): the dungeon cellars on L-2 (y -18): the stair down from the Scullery Passage's south wall (x 29..33, z 45..61), the south vault (x 29..42, z 61..69), the long cellar under the kitchens (x 34..42, z 0..61) and the stair up into the kitchens' corridor's north wall (x 29.5..33.5, z 4..20) and its foot landing (x 29.5..34, z 0..4). The dungeon stone (castle_wall_d, castle_floor_dungeon) under the flat ribbed ceiling; the long cellar's bays on both walls at the same lines (runs.bounds, ribs across); torch-lit (kit_torch_wall on its shafts and the vault's, six bringing lights); barrels on oak cradles (kit_cellar_barrels) in five bays, two wine racks (kit_wine_rack) along the vault's south wall by the wine-racks find spot, the dry well (kit_well_dry, reused) by the old-well find spot; the steps solid between their walls with skirts, their arches without quoins (assemble.py, as the basement steps). The long cellar's east wall at z 10..14 is left plain for passage end.

passage_tapestry._doc: P1 (Secrets): the Weaver's Back Stair, kitted in the new `passage` kind: a 2 m stair from the fifth-floor west corridor's south wall (door x -71..-69, landing z 9..13.5, y 45) down west 4.5 m south of the corridors (x -85..-71, z 11.5..13.5) to the fourth-floor vestibule's south wall (landing and door x -87..-85, y 36); stacked over P3. Rough dungeon stone, a low ceiling on oak timbers over the stair (kit_passage_ceiling, 3.5 m over the treads, the camera's too), solid steps with skirts, plain arches, three torches, rubble at the foot. Entered behind the floor-length tapestries kit_entrance_tapestry in l5_corridor_west (the Heron at the Ford) and l4_corridor_west (the Climbing Stair).

passage_panel._doc: P2 (Secrets): the Trophy Cabinet Stair, kitted in the `passage` kind: from the Trophy Room's west wall (door z -29..-27, y 0) a switchback of two 4.5 m flights west of the room (x -20..-8, z -30..-24) up to the first floor, a walk over the Trophy Room's roof (z -18..-16, y 9) to the First-Floor North Corridor's north wall (door x 1..3). Rough dungeon stone, low ceilings on oak timbers over both flights, solid steps with skirts, plain arches, four torches. Entered behind the sliding trophy case kit_entrance_panel (case) in trophy_room and a plain oak panel (kit_entrance_panel case 0) in ff_corridor_north.

passage_painting._doc: P3 (Secrets): the Reader's Shortcut, kitted in the `passage` kind: behind a painting, a 2 m stair from the library's east wall (door z 11.5..13.5, y 18) up east 4.5 m south of the corridors (x -92..-76) to a landing (x -76..-72, z 9..13.5, y 27) and the Charms corridor's south wall (door x -75..-73). Rough dungeon stone, a low ceiling on oak timbers over the stair, solid steps with skirts, plain arches, three torches. Entered behind the paintings kit_entrance_painting in sf_library (the Lantern Tower) and tf_corridor_west (a Reader's Still Life).

passage_statue._doc: P4 (Secrets): the Sculptor's Gap, kitted in the `passage` kind: from the Long Gallery's south wall (door x 60..62, y 9) a landing (x 59..63, z -2..2) and a 2 m stair down west (x 43..59, z 0..2) in the gap north of the Great Hall, to a landing (x 38..43, z -6..2) and a short walk (x 34..38, z -6..-4) to the Undercroft Walk's east wall (door z -6..-4, y 0). Rough dungeon stone, a low ceiling on oak timbers over the stair, solid steps with skirts, plain arches, three torches, rubble at the foot. Entered behind the scholar's statue kit_entrance_statue in ff_gallery_east and a plain stretch of wall (kit_entrance_wall) in gf_undercroft.

passage_dungeon._doc: P5 (Secrets): the Cellarer's Way, kitted in the `passage` kind: through a dungeon wall, from the dungeon corridor's east wall (door z 30..32, y -9) a landing and a 2 m stair down north under the Entrance Hall (x 14..16, z 13..29), a low corridor (z 1..13, then east z 1..3) to the dungeon cellars' foot landing (door x 27.5..29.5, y -18). No outside. Rough dungeon stone, a low ceiling on oak timbers over the stair, solid steps with skirts, plain arches, four torches, rubble in the walk. Entered through plain stretches of dungeon wall (kit_entrance_wall) in dungeon_west and dungeon_cellars.
